meta.title: Contractor register — San Francisco
meta.data_as_of: CSLB pages report 'Data current as of 11/7/2026 12:16–12:20 PM' (Pacific). Each row records the timestamp shown on the page it was read from.
meta.method: Every row in this file was read directly from the official CSLB licence-detail page for that licence number on 2026-11-07. Company names, status wording, classification codes, issue/expiry dates, address, phone, bond and workers'-compensation status are transcribed from those pages. Nothing was inferred and no field was taken from a third-party directory.
meta.not_verified: Company websites, Yelp/BBB ratings, review counts, service areas beyond the CSLB address, willingness to take this job, availability and prices were NOT verified. Yelp returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval on 2026-11-07, so no rating or review count is published anywhere in this dataset.
meta.cslb_warning: CSLB states on every licence page that licence status can change at any time and that the database may not yet reflect recent changes. Re-check the linked page immediately before signing any contract.
meta.license_types: C-36 = Plumbing Contractor; B = General Building Contractor; A = General Engineering; B-2 = Residential Remodeling; C-4 = Boiler/Hot Water Heating; C-10 = Electrical; C-16 = Fire Protection; C-20 = Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning.
meta.merged: This dataset merges two 2026-11-07 verification passes: the CSLB re-read performed for this build (19 licence numbers) and an independent re-read of 13 of them by the final-integration pass that preceded it. Where both recorded a value they agree. Company website URLs were carried over from that pass and are labelled as not re-checked here.

providers.name: SAVE - ON - INTERIOR
providers.fit: The strongest all-in-one candidate on paper: one licence holding B (General Building) and C-36 (Plumbing), at the same address and phone number CSLB lists for Bay Area Plumbing, which has already quoted the requester $550.

The CSLB record does not name the qualifying individual for either licence on the public detail page, so the inference that one operator runs both is an inference from two official records, not a stated fact — confirm before contracting (F-06).
